basic_details.job_title: KSMC LD Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Two LD Clerk posts in the office of the Kerala State Medical Council are to be filled on deputation (foreign service). Only employees now working in a similar post in the State Government, semi-government bodies or public sector institutions can apply, and they must apply through proper channel. Applications must reach the Registrar, Kerala State Medical Councils, Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram-35, by 5.00 PM on 20 November 2026.

qualification.details: Who can apply: persons working in a similar post in the State Government, semi-government bodies or public sector institutions. Qualification: the qualification prescribed for the similar post in Government service. Service: not less than one year of service in the said post. Pay scale: applications from candidates in a higher pay scale will not be considered. Age limit: not specified in the notice. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

important_instructions: The appointment is on deputation (foreign service) basis. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Applications from those in a higher pay scale will not be considered. More details are on the website www.medicalcouncil.kerala.gov.in. For enquiries, the office phone is 0471 2557227 and the email is [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About KSMC LD Clerk
content_sections.text: Kerala State Medical Councils has its office on Redcross road, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala (PIN 695035). The LD Clerk posts are in the office of the Kerala State Medical Council. The notice was issued by the Registrar on 06-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes through proper channel, meaning it must be forwarded by your present department. It is sent in the prescribed format to this address: Registrar, Kerala State Medical Councils, Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram-35 The application must reach this address by 5.00 PM on 20 November 2026. The notice does not say how the application must be sent (post, courier or by hand), and it does not say what to write on the envelope. The form to use is the one prescribed in Rule 144 of KSR Part I.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Who can apply: persons working in a similar post in the State Government, semi-government bodies or public sector institutions. Qualification: the qualification prescribed for the similar post in Government service. Service: not less than one year of service in the said post. Pay scale: applications from candidates in a higher pay scale will not be considered. Age limit: not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the head of the department concerned The form prescribed in Rule 144 of KSR Part I Biodata

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KSMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 LD Clerk posts, to be filled on deputation (foreign service).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the KSMC LD Clerk deputation application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Registrar by 5.00 PM on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the KSMC LD Clerk posts?
faq.answer: Persons working in a similar post in the State Government, semi-government bodies or public sector institutions can apply, through proper channel.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for KSMC LD Clerk?
faq.answer: You need the qualification of the similar post in Government service. You also need not less than one year of service in that post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale of KSMC LD Clerk?
faq.answer: The pay scale is 26500-60700. Applications from those in a higher pay scale will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the KSMC LD Clerk deputation?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format, through proper channel, to the Registrar, Kerala State Medical Councils, Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram-35. It must reach there by 5.00 PM on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must be attached to the KSMC LD Clerk application?
faq.answer: Attach the NOC from the head of the department concerned, the form prescribed in Rule 144 of KSR Part I, and a biodata.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KSMC LD Clerk appointment a direct recruitment?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled on deputation (foreign service) from employees already working in similar posts.

faq.question: Q9. Will incomplete applications be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Incomplete applications will not be considered.
